title: Native runtime: run a deterministic sensor-to-actuator bench loop
build: Boot an owned runtime on one selected development board, read a timestamped synthetic sensor sample and drive a disabled-load test output with a measurable deadline. Choose the board and toolchain from measured timing and supported hardware rather than running a JavaScript motor loop on Linux.
criteria: Record board selection, licence/provenance, toolchain and reproducible boot/flash procedure.
Demonstrate scheduler deadlines, memory bounds, hardware watchdog, safe reset and neutral outputs on a test harness.
Version the Pi-to-runtime transport and capability handshake; reject incompatible versions and stale authority.
Keep TypeScript mission logic separate from the board HAL. Record any required firmware-language exception explicitly before implementation.
remaining: Physical Pico 2 boot/flash evidence
Logic-analyser loop/deadline and neutral-output measurements
Measured stack high-water and hardware watchdog/reset behavior
Physical Pi-to-Pico UART freshness and reset campaign

title: Sensors: calibrate and replay time-aligned IMU, GNSS and pressure samples
build: Capture one real board IMU plus GNSS/barometer data into a typed sensor stream and reproduce the same stream through the simulator.
criteria: Specify units, frames, covariance, sensor identity, monotonic capture time and quality flags.
Implement calibration, temperature compensation, dropout/stuck-sensor detection and independent sample-age checks.
Retain a reproducible capture/replay dataset and tests for timestamp skew and axis conventions.
remaining: Physical ICM-42688-P, BMP280 and GNSS disabled-load capture with hardware identities
Measured mount, six-orientation, stationary, thermal and noise calibration
Measured acquisition/group delay, transport timing and GNSS PPS/TIM-TP alignment
Hardware dropout/stuck fault campaign and issue #2 timing/watchdog gates

title: Estimation: publish owned attitude and local-position estimates
build: Estimate attitude and local pose from the recorded sensor stream and expose estimator health to the application without depending on either external autopilot.
criteria: Validate orientation conventions, NED origin and altitude datum with independent reference data.
Quantify attitude/position error and estimator reset behavior under GNSS, compass and IMU failures.
Add a replayable first estimator implementation and document the path to EKF fusion, VIO, optical flow, RTK and multi-sensor redundancy.
remaining: Issue #3 physical capture/calibration/timing prerequisites and independent estimator reference campaign
Absolute-heading sensor and disturbance/failure validation
Full-covariance inertial EKF, biases, height-datum fusion and delay compensation
VIO, optical flow, RTK, redundancy and measured native-board estimator port

title: Multirotor control: stabilize the first simulated quadcopter
build: Use owned rate, attitude, velocity and position control with a quad-X actuator allocation model to stabilize a physics simulator, then a disabled-prop bench harness.
criteria: Verify controller units, saturation, anti-windup, slew limits and actuator mixing against independent worked cases.
Demonstrate step responses, wind/disturbance rejection and sensor-delay tolerance in a physics model.
Keep board outputs inhibited until the separately validated authority supervisor permits them.
Include a scoped continuation list for tuning, autotune, helicopter/autorotation and advanced control variants.
remaining: Measured estimator/heading/timing prerequisites in #2/#3/#4
Higher-fidelity models, noisy/biased sensors, parameter and delay sweeps, and stability margins
Native scheduler port and disabled-prop harness with #6 authority gating
Measured tuning, autotune, helicopter/autorotation and advanced controller variants

title: Authority: verify arming, manual override and independent failsafes
build: Give an operator explicit control authority and predictable disarm, mode, RC-loss, estimator-loss, fence, battery, link-loss and watchdog behavior across the native simulator and board harness.
criteria: Model authority as a versioned state machine and test all legal and illegal transitions.
Exercise RC override, stale commands, Pi termination, board reset, sensor faults and battery reserve in HIL.
Verify safe outputs for physical kill/disarm and document recovery requirements without relying on a final network command.
Capture parachute, rally/recovery, emergency landing and redundant-link requirements as explicit supported or deferred cases.
remaining: Native board supervisor port after physical #2/#3/#4/#5 prerequisites
Measured physical RC/kill/disarm and independent output isolation on a disabled-load harness
HIL Pi termination, board reset, sensor/link faults and battery reserve campaign
Manual sticks, emergency landing/rally/recovery, parachute and redundant-link integrations with independent evidence

title: Drivers: implement acknowledged MAVLink commands, missions and parameters
build: Extend the current explicit ArduPilot and PX4 adapters behind one capability-negotiated contract; support a complete acknowledged command, parameter and mission round trip with each simulator.
criteria: Implement target discovery, message-rate negotiation, COMMAND_ACK/retries, mission upload/download/resume and parameter read/write with cancellation and bounds.
Add signing verification, replay handling, source routing, transport loss, serial/UDP/TCP and version compatibility tests.
Track FTP/log download, events, RTC/time sync, RTCM, payload/gimbal protocols, DDS/ROS 2 and CAN gateways as explicit sub-capabilities.
Keep physical write capability disabled until separate HIL/flight evidence exists; publish driver-specific support rather than assuming MAVLink implies parity.
remaining: Pinned ArduPilot/PX4 firmware SITL round trips, supported commands, mission variants and measured message rates
Serial/TCP stream transport, reconnect/backpressure and hardware/HIL authority evidence
Signing key lifecycle, persistent replay watermarks and cross-restart campaigns
COMMAND_INT/remote cancellation, full mission/parameter protocols and ownership reconciliation
Explicit FTP/log/event/time/RTCM, payload/gimbal, DDS/ROS 2 and CAN gateway services

title: Hardware adapters: command and verify the first camera or payload
build: Trigger one camera/payload through an owned hardware adapter and correlate the acknowledgement and timestamp with the recorded vehicle pose.
criteria: Define SPI/I2C/UART/CAN/DroneCAN/Cyphal, GPIO/PWM/DShot and power-monitor adapter contracts with bounded timing.
Validate a first real device end to end, including time sync, calibration, wiring and bus failure.
Inventory gimbals, LiDAR/rangefinders, thermal/multispectral cameras, ESC telemetry, grippers, winches, relays, lights, transponders and sampling hardware.

title: Operations: record, replay and diagnose native missions
build: Record a mission with enough timestamped telemetry, commands and configuration provenance to reproduce a failure and inspect it in the Stacks UI.
criteria: Implement bounded black-box logs, loss accounting, replay and export without leaking operator tokens or private imagery by default.
Record firmware/config/model/calibration versions, performance deadlines, health events and reset causes.
Cover crash capture, diagnostics, signed update/rollback, storage exhaustion and commissioning checks.

title: Mission engine: run and resume an owned waypoint mission
build: Plan, validate, execute, pause, resume and recover a simple geofenced mission in the owned simulator with a visible mission state in Stacks.
criteria: Version mission graph and task semantics; include waypoint, takeoff, land, loiter, return, payload trigger and abort behavior.
Validate coordinate frames, terrain/altitude reference, fence/rally constraints and power/endurance budget.
Prove cancellation, checkpoint recovery and conditional branches from recorded mission traces.

title: Navigation: avoid an obstacle and land at a selected site
build: Demonstrate one sensor-backed avoidance and precision-landing scenario in a physics simulator before planning hardware trials.
criteria: Use measured perception latency and uncertainty in collision constraints, terrain following and braking envelopes.
Separate detection, path planning, control and authority; fail closed on missing range/position.
Cover follow, orbit, route replanning, RTL, landing-target estimation and terrain/geofence interactions.

title: Air vehicles: add fixed-wing, VTOL and helicopter simulation profiles
build: Complete a fixed-wing mission through the shared planner and owned vehicle-control contracts, then explicitly inventory VTOL, helicopter and other airframe gaps.
criteria: Separate vehicle-specific dynamics, allocation, transition, airspeed and energy management from common missions.
Demonstrate fixed-wing navigation and landing with wind and stall constraints in simulation.
Track VTOL transitions, TECS/soaring, helicopters, blimps/airships and experimental spacecraft as separate evidence-gated extensions.

title: Ground vehicles: execute a rover logistics or mowing route
build: Run a differential or Ackermann ground vehicle over a constrained mowing/site-logistics route with stop and recovery controls.
criteria: Model steering geometry, wheel odometry, traction, stopping distance and implement interlocks.
Verify obstacles, people proximity, RC/manual override, loss of localization and emergency stop.
Expose coverage planning, site logistics and materials-handling payload tasks through the common mission UI.

title: Surface vessels: survey a water route and collect a sample
build: Plan and simulate a surface-vessel survey line with time-aligned depth/position data and a commanded water sample.
criteria: Model vessel actuation, current/wind, return-to-safe-point and collision constraints.
Specify sonar/depth, sound-speed, water-level and datum corrections with uncertainty and export metadata.
Verify sample location, timestamp, container identity and payload acknowledgement; include harbour-work recovery.

title: Subsea ROV: inspect a structure through a tethered control profile
build: Control an owned simulated ROV with depth hold, tether supervision and an inspection task for hulls, dams, pipelines or aquaculture pens.
criteria: Implement 6-DOF thruster allocation, pressure/depth convention, leak detection and buoyancy assumptions.
Demonstrate tether/link loss, depth limits, emergency behavior and operator takeover.
Record sonar/camera evidence against a local navigation frame and specify topside/tether hardware.

title: Antenna tracking: point a pan-tilt mount at a telemetry target
build: Point a bounded pan-tilt antenna at a selected vehicle using surveyed tracker origin and current telemetry.
criteria: Validate geodetic transforms, north/reference calibration, angular wrap and mechanical travel limits.
Handle stale target, lost telemetry, cable twist and manual override without uncontrolled motion.
Demonstrate pointing accuracy on a bench mount and correlate signal/link quality.

title: Vision: localize a selected target and fuse camera observations
build: Turn the current 2D selected-person observation into a calibrated local-frame measurement only when range/depth and vehicle pose are available.
criteria: Calibrate intrinsics/extrinsics, lens/ROI mapping, synchronization and position uncertainty against independent ground truth.
Pair the visual lock with a chosen GNSS/target source explicitly; never infer metres from an uncalibrated box.
Test crossings, occlusion, reacquisition, identity drift and camera loss; add appearance tracking only with measured privacy and accuracy behavior.

title: Aerial mapping: fly a camera-triggered survey with georeferenced imagery
build: Plan and simulate a survey polygon with altitude, GSD and image-overlap constraints and produce an auditable georeferenced photo dataset.
criteria: Implement boundary clipping, crosshatch/terrain options, camera footprints, trigger timing and flight/endurance estimates.
Associate exposure timestamps, pose, camera calibration and RTK/PPK/GCP metadata with every image.
Export interoperable photogrammetry inputs and quality reports; distinguish collection from reconstruction.

title: Survey processing: measure a stockpile from a LiDAR or photogrammetric surface
build: Process a known georeferenced point cloud/surface into a stockpile boundary, base surface and volume report for mining or construction.
criteria: Specify CRS, vertical datum, units, boresight/time calibration, ground classification and georeferencing error.
Implement an auditable TIN/grid or equivalent integration method with user-defined base assumptions and independent analytic fixtures.
Report coverage gaps, uncertainty, cut/fill, export formats and comparison against a surveyed reference.
Keep LiDAR acquisition, photogrammetric reconstruction and volume computation separately identifiable.

title: Infrastructure inspection: repeat an asset route and attach evidence
build: Run a repeatable stand-off inspection route for one asset and attach visible/thermal imagery and observations to its geometry.
criteria: Demonstrate asset-relative planning and clearances for a selected power-line, turbine, solar, bridge or pipeline case.
Record inspection position, camera pose, capture quality and human-reviewed defect annotations.
Test GNSS degradation, moving structure/wind, mission interruption and repeat-visit comparability.

title: Agriculture sensing: scout a field with calibrated multispectral data
build: Plan a crop-scouting route and produce a calibrated field observation layer from multispectral or visible imagery.
criteria: Record irradiance/reference-panel calibration, bands, camera synchronization and geospatial metadata.
Verify an index/map calculation against a known dataset; document agronomic inference limits.
Include explicit selected-animal livestock observations and field/parcel reporting without automatic identity claims.

title: Agriculture application: simulate spraying and spreading with interlocks
build: Simulate a prescription map driving a sprayer/spreader with bounded actuation and auditable application records.
criteria: Implement rate/flow or mass calibration, speed compensation, exclusion zones, empty-tank and stuck-valve detection.
Require explicit implement authority, emergency shutoff and a test mode that cannot energize hardware.
Record material, coverage, overlaps, drift/weather constraints and local operational requirements before any physical trial.

title: Public safety: coordinate search, fire and disaster observation missions
build: Give authorized operators a coordinated search/disaster mission workflow with live observations and an auditable handover.
criteria: Demonstrate search-area planning, thermal/visible evidence, incident annotations and team handover in simulation.
Define role-based access, retention, privacy and operator review for rescue, firefighting and lawful police observation.
Handle communications loss, incident boundaries and resource/endurance changes without autonomous person enforcement.

title: Patrol: repeat a scheduled mission and dock under supervised authority
build: Schedule, execute, inspect and repeat a simulated perimeter mission with docking/charging and explicit launch authority.
criteria: Implement dock alignment/landing, weather/power interlocks, contact/charge verification and abort/recovery.
Keep scheduling separate from permission to launch; expose operator review and audit records.
Test recurrence, missed runs, link loss, denied access and failure to dock without silently retrying a hazardous launch.

title: Cargo: simulate delivery, redundant links and a BVLOS operations case
build: Run a simulated delivery route with payload custody, reserve/alternate landing planning and loss-of-link contingencies.
criteria: Model mass/CG changes, release verification, recipient/site confirmation and endurance margins.
Exercise redundant links, degraded navigation, containment, diversion and fleet handover in simulation.
Document the required authorization/detect-and-avoid/operational evidence for long-range BVLOS separately from software capability.

title: Cinematography: coordinate a repeatable camera path and gimbal
build: Execute a smooth repeatable simulated camera path while controlling a stabilized gimbal, lens and exposure timeline.
criteria: Validate jerk/acceleration limits, POI/orbit/dolly paths and synchronized vehicle/gimbal frames.
Record precise trigger/video timecode and camera command acknowledgements.
Test operator handoff, target loss, mechanical gimbal limits and interruption/resume.

title: Environment: survey wildlife or atmosphere with traceable samples
build: Plan and simulate a monitoring mission with georeferenced observations and calibrated environmental samples.
criteria: Track sensor calibration, timestamp/location, sample chain of custody and uncertainty.
Include wildlife disturbance/exclusion constraints, authorized anti-poaching observation and human review.
Demonstrate sampling-payload failure, geofence changes and reproducible data export.

title: Parity audit: expand the pinned upstream inventory into behavior-level coverage
build: Maintain a reviewed feature-by-feature matrix for every pinned PX4 module/driver and ArduPilot library/vehicle family, with executable evidence for claimed native or adapter support.
criteria: Keep all 274 current top-level inventory entries assigned to implementation work; classify currently unclassified details explicitly.
Expand directory entries into parameter, mode, protocol, hardware variant and failure-behavior cases; do not treat a directory mapping as feature parity.
Automate upstream revision refresh and fail a coverage check for unassigned/new entries or dangling issue links.
Record licence/provenance, firmware versions, simulator/HIL/vehicle evidence and known unsupported behavior for every claimed capability.

title: Pi AI Camera: complete on-device capture and loss-validation evidence
build: Run the implemented IMX500 bridge and tracker on the owner's Pi 5/AI Camera, recording a reproducible compatibility and target-loss test report.
criteria: Record Pi OS, Picamera2, model firmware, inference-metadata ABI and camera versions.
Measure inference rate/age, preview latency, IPC backpressure, CPU, temperature and undervoltage under sustained load.
Exercise explicit selection, crossings, low confidence, empty tensors, repeated frame counters, unplug/worker exit, stalls and restart.
Fix any observed hardware incompatibilities before claiming on-device support; no vehicle actuation is required for this desk test.
